correctness.rationale: The principal unit group 1+tF[[t]] is uniquely p-divisible in characteristic zero. Thus F((t))× modulo pth powers is F×/(F×)^p times Z/p; from algebraically closed F0 this gives size p^r at depth r. Touchard Theorem 3.11 (with stagewise angular map) gives bdn(K_ac)=bdn(enriched residue)+bdn(Z), Corollary 3.13 (under finite power quotients without ac) gives max, and Remark 3.15 explicitly allows enriched residue/value sorts resplendently. At each step bdn(Z)=1, and base ACF bdn=1, so direct induction yields 1 without ac, r+1 with ac. This is correct under the expressly recursive multi-sorted languages; the bundled verifier checks only the arithmetic recurrence, not Touchard model-theoretic theorems.
